changes: Rebuilt BEEP_*.mp3 as PC-speaker-like 50% duty square-wave samples instead of sine-wave tones.
Rebuilt the nine MUSIC_*.mp3 tracks from the exact MUSIC.PAS byte sequences and source note frequencies.
Modelled MUSIC.PAS PlayMusic as a source event stream: NoSound each call, then Beep only when the source state reaches a note byte.
Used 70 Hz source timing because VGA256.PAS SetViewport waits for vertical retrace and PLAY.PAS calls PlayMusic immediately after ShowPage.
Changed Python audio presentation to one shared pygame mixer channel for music and sound effects, matching the single DOS PC-speaker path in BUFFERS.PAS.
Removed same-frequency suppression: every source Beep call now replaces/restarts the speaker sample, matching Crt.Sound semantics.
Kept the gameplay/render loop timing unchanged; only the audio scheduler follows the source 70 Hz cadence.
runtime_note: The full MUSIC_*.mp3 files are retained as source-timed reference/presentation assets. Runtime playback uses the MP3 BEEP samples plus the translated MUSIC.PAS state machine so a gameplay Beep can interrupt music on the same channel, as in DOS.
